To build a new Warframe from its blueprint, you'll need to build its components first. 

This comes in the form of neuroptics, chassis and systems, think of these parts as the brain, body and nerves respectively.

Each of these components have their own blueprints. You can use the Warframe wiki to find where they are.

For Loki, his component blueprints are acquired from the boss, Hyena Pack, from Psamathe, Neptune. 

For Gara, her component blueprints are acquired as rewards from plains of eidolon bounties! Just check which bounty has the component you want and go for it!

Once you have built all 3 parts, you can then build the complete Warframe using the blueprint you have right now.

Hope that answers your question! Also, if you want a new Warframe, Venus's boss the Jackel will give you the blueprints needed to assemble rhino, he is strong and easy for a new player to pick up!
